summary: Externalize the sandbox preview host into a single PUBLIC_HOST configuration boundary so that user-facing Live App URLs reflect the publicly reachable address (192.168.1.147) rather than the container-local 'localhost'. The host is read once at module scope in both the generator (initial preview_url written during sandbox generation) and the runner (previewUrl written on run and restart) and is injected through the docker-compose backend environment. Internal service connection strings and container healthchecks remain on localhost because they are consumed inside the container/local-developer context and are not user-navigable.
components: generator.js PUBLIC_HOST module constant (process.env.PUBLIC_HOST || 'localhost') feeding the preview_url written by generateSandbox at the environments UPDATE
runner.js PUBLIC_HOST module constant feeding previewUrl in both runSandbox and restartSandbox paths via updateEnvironmentStatus
docker-compose.yml backend service environment entry PUBLIC_HOST=192.168.1.147 supplying the runtime value to the backend container
environmentService.updateEnvironmentStatus as the persistence sink that stores the host-qualified previewUrl onto the environment record
Port allocation (ports.js) host_port values that are concatenated with PUBLIC_HOST to form http://PUBLIC_HOST:PORT preview URLs
E2E Playwright suite (9 tests) plus public-endpoint probe at http://192.168.1.147:3000 used by the downstream testing stage to confirm availability and host-qualified preview URLs
constraints: PUBLIC_HOST must default to 'localhost' when unset so local/dev runs without the env var continue to function unchanged.

The host value must be read at module scope (not per call) consistent with the existing SANDBOX_BASE_DIR pattern; behavior is fixed at process start, so the backend container must be rebuilt/restarted to pick up a changed PUBLIC_HOST.
Only user-navigable preview URLs (preview_url in generator.js, previewUrl in runner.js run/restart) adopt PUBLIC_HOST.

Internal connection strings (postgresql/redis/amqp at generator.js lines 126/130/134) and the container healthcheck (generator.js line 281) must remain on localhost because they resolve inside the container or local-developer context, not from a remote browser.
generator.js and runner.js must produce identical host-qualified URL formatting (http://${PUBLIC_HOST}:${port}) so initial generation and subsequent run/restart never disagree on the preview host.
No API contract, route, or persistence schema changes; preview_url remains a single string column populated with the host-qualified value.

Acceptance for the downstream testing stage requires all 9 Playwright tests passing and an environment preview_url of http://192.168.1.147:PORT (not localhost), with the public site at http://192.168.1.147:3000 returning HTTP 200.
